command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

echo "== Beagle on the same fixture bytes =="
beagle gt=target.vcf ref=ref.vcf out=imputed nthreads=2 > beagle.log 2>&1
gunzip -f imputed.vcf.gz

echo "== score both against the hidden truth, and against each other =="
cat > final.awk <<'AWKEOF'
# args: truth.txt target.vcf beagle.vcf mm4.vcf
FILENAME ~ /truth/ { truth[$1"\t"$2]=$3; next }
FILENAME ~ /target/ && /^#CHROM/ { for(i=10;i<=NF;i++) tn[i]=$i; next }
FILENAME ~ /target/ && !/^#/ { for(i=10;i<=NF;i++){ g=$i; if(g!="./.") { gsub(/\|/,"/",g); split(g,a,"/"); obs[$3"\t"tn[i]]=a[1]+a[2] } } next }
FILENAME ~ /imputed/ && /^#CHROM/ { for(i=10;i<=NF;i++) bn[i]=$i; next }
FILENAME ~ /imputed/ && !/^#/ { for(i=10;i<=NF;i++){ split($i,f,":"); g=f[1]; gsub(/\|/,"/",g); split(g,a,"/"); if(a[1]!=".") B[$3"\t"bn[i]]=a[1]+a[2] } next }
FILENAME ~ /mm4/ && /^#CHROM/ { for(i=10;i<=NF;i++) mn[i]=$i; next }
FILENAME ~ /mm4/ && !/^#/ { for(i=10;i<=NF;i++){ split($i,f,":"); g=f[1]; gsub(/\|/,"/",g); split(g,a,"/"); if(a[1]!=".") M[$3"\t"mn[i]]=a[1]+a[2] } next }
END{
  for(k in truth){
    nm++
    if(k in B){ bfill++; if(B[k]==truth[k]) bok++ }
    if(k in M){ mfill++; if(M[k]==truth[k]) mok++ }
    if((k in B) && (k in M)){ agr_n++; if(B[k]==M[k]) agr++; if(B[k]!=truth[k] && M[k]!=truth[k]) both_wrong++ }
  }
  for(k in obs){ no++; if((k in B) && B[k]!=obs[k]) bchg++; if((k in M) && M[k]!=obs[k]) mchg++ }
  printf "masked_total %d\n", nm
  printf "beagle_filled %d  beagle_concordance %.4f\n", bfill, (bfill?bok/bfill:0)
  printf "minimac4_filled %d  minimac4_concordance %.4f\n", mfill, (mfill?mok/mfill:0)
  printf "tool_agreement %.4f on %d shared\n", (agr_n?agr/agr_n:0), agr_n
  printf "both_wrong %d  (shared misses => data-limited, not implementation)\n", both_wrong+0
  printf "observed_total %d  beagle_changed %d  minimac4_changed %d\n", no, bchg+0, mchg+0
}
AWKEOF
awk -f final.awk truth.txt target.vcf imputed.vcf mm4.vcf > scores.txt
cat scores.txt

MT=$(awk '/^masked_total/{print $2}' scores.txt)
BF=$(awk '/^beagle_filled/{print $2}' scores.txt)
BC=$(awk '/^beagle_filled/{print $4}' scores.txt)
MF=$(awk '/^minimac4_filled/{print $2}' scores.txt)
MC=$(awk '/^minimac4_filled/{print $4}' scores.txt)
AG=$(awk '/^tool_agreement/{print $2}' scores.txt)
BW=$(awk '/^both_wrong/{print $2}' scores.txt)
OT=$(awk '/^observed_total/{print $2}' scores.txt)
BCH=$(awk '/^observed_total/{print $4}' scores.txt)
MCH=$(awk '/^observed_total/{print $6}' scores.txt)

{
  echo "Genotype imputation -- two tools, one fixture, truth we deleted ourselves"
  echo "beagle_version        5.5 (27Feb25.75f)"
  echo "minimac4_version      $(awk 'NR==1{print $NF}' mm4ver.txt 2>/dev/null)"
  echo "masked_genotypes      $MT   (hidden from both tools)"
  echo "beagle_filled         $BF of $MT   (assert all -- EXACT, no holes left)"
  echo "minimac4_filled       $MF of $MT   (assert all -- EXACT)"
  echo "beagle_concordance    $BC   (assert >= 0.95)"
  echo "minimac4_concordance  $MC   (assert >= 0.95)"
  echo "tool_agreement        $AG   (assert >= 0.98 -- cross-validation)"
  echo "shared_misses         $BW   of the errors are made by BOTH => data-limited, not implementation"
  echo "observed_genotypes    $OT"
  echo "beagle_changed        $BCH   (assert 0 -- EXACT: Beagle preserves what you typed)"
  echo "minimac4_changed      $MCH   (observation, NOT a failure: minimac4 re-estimates typed markers)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt

test "$BF" -eq "$MT"
test "$MF" -eq "$MT"
test "$BCH" -eq 0
awk -v x="$BC" 'BEGIN{exit !(x>=0.95)}'
awk -v x="$MC" 'BEGIN{exit !(x>=0.95)}'
awk -v x="$AG" 'BEGIN{exit !(x>=0.98)}'
awk -v c="$MCH" -v t="$OT" 'BEGIN{exit !(c/t < 0.01)}'
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
